label: Apologies & Politeness
description: Apologizing, excusing yourself, thanking, and softening requests politely.

missions.phrase: Извините, я не хотел вас обидеть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: a sincere apology. The verb извините is the polite formal form for saying sorry. The phrase не хотел вас обидеть means did not want to offend you, softening the mistake.

Strategic focus: politely getting attention. Простите asks forgiveness for the interruption, and можно вас на минутку is a soft request meaning may I have you for a minute. This is a common opener before asking a stranger something.
Strategic focus: apologizing for being late. Прошу прощения is a more formal apology meaning I ask your forgiveness. The noun опоздание means lateness or a delay, and за marks what you are sorry for.
Strategic focus: reassuring someone who apologized. Ничего страшного means it is nothing serious or no problem. The imperative не волнуйтесь tells the person not to worry, a calm and polite reply.
Strategic focus: taking responsibility. Моя вина means my fault, and виноват is the short adjective a man uses to say I am guilty or at fault. A woman would say виновата instead.
Strategic focus: thanking warmly. Большое спасибо means thank you very much, stronger than plain спасибо. The phrase за вашу помощь means for your help, naming what you are grateful for.
Strategic focus: replying to thanks. Пожалуйста here means you are welcome, the same word also used for please. Не за что literally means nothing to thank for, a casual polite reply.
Strategic focus: asking permission politely. Можно мне means may I, and войти means to enter or come in. Adding пожалуйста softens the request and keeps the tone courteous.

missions.phrase: Не могли бы вы говорить медленнее?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: softening a request. Не могли бы вы is a polite conditional meaning could you possibly. The verb говорить медленнее means to speak more slowly, a gentle way to ask for a favor.
Strategic focus: apologizing for the trouble. Извините за беспокойство means sorry for the bother, a polite phrase when you have taken someone's time. Всё хорошо reassures that everything is fine.
